Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the Role:

• Responsible for the fiat product globalization on mobile application and develop product strategies aligned with busniess goal

What You’ll Do:

• Create and maintain the app product roadmap, milestones and backlog with strategic priorities of various overseas market’s product penetration plan
• Drive global product & feature shipment and lead beta programs by define the product specification and collaborate with designers, engineers and business stakeholders
• Collect and consolidate customers feedback and facilitate user studies to build app product that reflect customers’ needs and requirement.
• Conduct market research and analyse data for different regions and work closely with oversea/local operations to deliver market-fit solutions.
• Facilitate the communication with cross-functional teams in overseas to coordinate project progress

What We’re Looking For:

• Deep experience in launching and managing large-scale, global products development cycle with a track record of successful outcomes
• 5+ years of product management experience; technical expertise required
• Methodical in determining customer needs, running prototypes and iterations and making data-driven decisions for product optimizations
• Experience with analyzing app traffic and internal data to drive changes in product and growth across the company
• Ability to specify product requirements in a clear, succinct manner and work with engineers to deliver on specifications
• Strong problem-solving, interpersonal and communication skills
• Comfortable with being involved in multiple roles and projects at the same time in a fast pacing environment
• Ability to jointly manage projects and keep them on schedule
• Strong collaboration skills to influence and inspire internal business team and cross-functional team to drive product adoption and market share

Nice to Haves:

• Relevant app product experience from internet company, preferably with e-commerce or peer to peer product experience
• Familiar with Web 3 and DeFi eocosystem, protocal and platformExperience in AML and risk control modeling is a plus

Why Binance

• Shape the future of finance
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)
